thread:
marta: Quick Q — running into a mismatch when streaming tool outputs in the Go SDK. Runtime is sending an optional field as null but our typed struct expects it to be absent (omitempty). json.Unmarshal fails. Anyone seen this?

alex: Ugh yeah. Classic Go/JSON mismatch. Two paths: change the struct to use pointers/special nullable types, or add an SDK coercion that treats explicit null as missing for optional fields. Which do you prefer?

samir: Can you paste the exact error + a tiny payload that reproduces?

marta: Sure — minimal payload and error:
```
{"tool_result": {"items": null}}
```
Go struct: 
```go
type ToolResult struct {
  Items []Item `json:\"items,omitempty\"`
}
```
Error: `json: cannot unmarshal null into Go value of type []main.Item`

cheng: Yep. In Go if you have a slice the decoder doesn't convert null->nil for a typed slice. Pointer/special-type is the idiomatic fix. But for SDK ergonomics we added a helper in other libs: CoerceNullOptionals — it walks the raw JSON and deletes keys where value is null for declared optional fields before decoding.

alex: Important detail: our streaming path currently treats the final structured payload as opaque and skips that pre-decode pass. So even though CoerceNullOptionals exists for non-streaming, streaming consumers still hit the crash. I can open a PR to plug coercion into the streamer finalizer.

marta: Prefer an SDK-level fix so every language client benefits and customers don't have to change their models.

samir: Another gotcha — some runtimes will send null for nested optional properties even when outer object is present. Coercion logic needs to be recursive. Also consider whether to make this behavior opt-in.

cheng: We added a client config flag `EnableNullAsMissing` in the TS/py SDKs for backwards compatibility. Default false to avoid surprising strict decoders. Maybe add same to Go and the runtime docs?

marta: Makes sense. Do we have tests that cover streaming + nulls?

alex: Will add tests: unit for the coercion transformer + an integration that streams a small tool call with `items: null` and ensures decode succeeds into Go struct. I'll also add a python test to verify cross-lang parity.

ci-bot: deploy: canary build available at ci/12345 — alex/streaming-null-coerce — tests running (ETA ~12m)

samir: One more thought: for function/tool calling where schema says field is required but server sends null, we should still error loudly. Coercion should only target fields marked optional in the schema.

cheng: Good call — coercion transformer will accept the schema so we only drop nulls for optional keys. I'll add a small schema-driven helper interface.

marta: Awesome. Alex — ping me when PR is up, I'll do a quick review. If you can include the test payloads in the PR that'll speed it up.

alex: On it, aiming EOD.

marta: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
